domainConclusions.statement: Manual, chat and EDL paths share persisted overlay shapes and renderers but do not share one command/revision/receipt/proof contract; this is partial convergence, not UI/chat parity.
The live manual/chat transition command remains a partial-commit multiwrite and bypasses the atomic transition form used by EDL.
Canonical chat caption create/restyle has one form/track owner and one CAS persistence call, but manual authored captions and fancy HTML captions remain separate execution authorities.

The main renderer handles 13 timeline overlay cases, uses separate browser/render video components, hardcodes 30-fps behavior in video paths and can render placeholders/fallbacks rather than failing with UNVERIFIABLE.
This conclusion exists to bind the complete 27-file visual-domain evidence set; every path remains source evidence rather than a certification claim.
